objective: Build the largest defensible PIT backtest universe and the richest event-level information set possible before any new linked-asset outcome reveal.

optimization_dimensions.temporal_depth: maximize PIT observations per event across venues/contracts/time
optimization_dimensions.informational_breadth: maximize justified venues, contracts, assets, horizons and data layers without pseudo-replication
optimization_dimensions.validation_depth: maximize pre-registered robustness, falsification and dependence-aware inference

stop_rule: Do not stop solely because a milestone N is reached. Stop expansion only when additional sources/routes provide immaterial marginal gain, fail PIT/provenance/reproducibility gates, are economically unjustified, or are infeasible under time/cost constraints.

current_blocker.failure: HTTP 400 from historical/markets when querying a series
current_blocker.policy: Fix API-contract handling only; do not alter the frozen W4 family dictionary or read linked-asset outcomes.

execution_order.name: Maximal Backtest Research
execution_order.goal: Map all defensible venues, event families, PIT histories, linked-asset data layers and validation techniques that can expand N, depth or breadth.

execution_order.name: Repair and validate Kalshi census
execution_order.goal: Resolve the current HTTP 400, validate live/historical routing, pagination, trades and candles, and materialize a reproducible series-first capacity result.

execution_order.name: Exhaustive multi-venue census
execution_order.goal: Census all approved venues/families/years using frozen performance-blind semantics.

execution_order.name: Attrition and saturation audit
execution_order.goal: Measure raw -> semantic -> independent -> PIT -> asset-mapped -> final-backtestable attrition and marginal contribution of every expansion route.

execution_order.name: Canonical data lake
execution_order.goal: Materialize event-centric tables keyed by canonical_event_id and preserve raw-response hashes/provenance.

execution_order.name: Maximal feature materialization
execution_order.goal: Extract probability level/dynamics, liquidity, ladder/distribution, cross-venue disagreement, multi-asset mappings and other pre-event features without treating correlated measurements as independent events.

execution_order.name: Outcome-blind adequacy and simulation
execution_order.goal: Select complexity, regularization, portfolio constraints, horizons, multiplicity and inference using missingness/collinearity/effective-N analysis and synthetic outcomes only.

execution_order.name: Full W4 protocol freeze
execution_order.goal: Freeze population, features, mappings, models, tuning process, execution, costs, portfolio accounting, benchmarks, inference, multiplicity, falsification, stop and promotion rules.

execution_order.name: Single controlled outcome reveal
execution_order.goal: Open linked-asset outcomes once for the frozen population and produce an immutable hashed outcome bundle.

execution_order.name: Backtest battery
execution_order.goal: Execute BT-A expanded discrete replication, BT-B continuous all-event portfolio, BT-C distributional multi-venue model, event-response surfaces and microstructure studies where data permits.

execution_order.name: Maximal validation battery
execution_order.goal: Run temporal OOS, walk-forward/cross-fitting, clustered/bootstrap inference, multiplicity control, stability, cost/liquidity stress and falsification tests.

execution_order.name: W4 scientific truth freeze
execution_order.goal: Freeze the final W4 result whether positive, negative or data-limited, while preserving the original H2 FAIL and C0_NO_TRADE historical champion.

canonical_independence_rule: canonical_event_id is the default inferential unit. Multiple markets, strikes, venues, assets, horizons, quotes, trades or ticks may increase information per event but never automatically increase independent N.

continue_if_any: material increase in independent canonical events
material increase in pre-event temporal depth
material increase in economically justified linked-asset breadth
material improvement in provenance or reproducibility
stop_if_all: remaining candidate sources add immaterial marginal coverage
remaining data are economically unjustified for the event family
remaining acquisition is infeasible under challenge time/cost constraints

forbidden_before_W4_H: post-hoc feature selection using economic performance
changing the frozen W4-BER-v1.0 family dictionary to inflate counts
counting correlated contracts/assets/horizons/ticks as independent events

relationship_to_prior_science.rule: W4 is a new post-freeze experiment program, not a rescue or reinterpretation of the frozen confirmatory result.

immediate_next_actions: Correct Kalshi historical API request construction without changing frozen family semantics
Re-run and byte-materialize the Kalshi series-first capacity census
Build the exhaustive venue/data-source research registry
Run multi-venue capacity and attrition census
Apply the saturation gate before designing the outcome-bearing W4 protocol
